name: joboostr
description: Find Joboostr jobs, tailor saved resumes and keep application materials and progress across devices.

interface.longDescription: Find job opportunities through your connected Joboostr account. Search by role, location and remote preference, review selected jobs, and check your remaining daily allowance. Each account shares an allowance of 100 distinct jobs per day across connected assistants; viewing the same job again that day does not use another allowance. Available job details depend on your account access. You can prepare application drafts in the conversation, but Joboostr does not submit applications through this plugin. An existing Joboostr account is required. With job-management approval, save a user-requested job found elsewhere to your private Tracking page with its application link, company, description and useful factual context. The saved job starts in Favourite and Not applied. Saving never submits an application or contacts an employer. Track Application process and AI Job Management separately. AI preparation stages are Match, Resume Match, Tailored Resume, Blocked, Review and Ready to apply. Human review is the default before readiness; tracking itself does not fill or submit employer forms. With separate application-material permission, save job-specific resumes, cover letters, structured answers, comments and continuation steps in your account. Review and edit them on Tracking, and continue across devices or assistants without rereading every document.
defaultPrompt: Find product designer jobs in Prague, Czechia.
How many Joboostr jobs can I still view today?
Save this outside job to my private Tracking with its application link and useful context.

positive.description: Core role/location search. Setup: signed-in dedicated account with at least five jobs remaining. Live results may be empty; do not invent matches.
positive.prompt: Find up to five product designer jobs in Prague, Czechia.
positive.expected_behavior: Read allowance, then search_jobs with roles containing product designer, locations containing Prague, Czechia (or equivalent canonical location), limit no greater than five or remaining allowance. Present only returned jobs with their returned Joboostr links; state no matches if empty.

positive.description: Remote filter and alternate location. Setup: signed-in account with at least three jobs remaining.
positive.prompt: Show me up to three remote software engineer jobs in Czechia.
positive.expected_behavior: Use software engineer role, Czechia location, remote=true and limit at most three/remaining allowance. Preserve country and remote constraint. Do not claim remote availability beyond returned data.

positive.description: Selected job details. Setup: first perform a successful search and retain its actual returned job_id; user refers to its first result. If no results, find a real result before running this case.
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first job you just found, including its requirements and the link to view it.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_job with the exact first returned job_id from context. Summarize only disclosed fields, preserve missing/redacted details, and link using the returned joboostr_url. Never fabricate requirements or an application submission.

positive.description: Account-wide remaining allowance without searching. Setup: signed-in dedicated account; compare with returned values rather than assuming a fresh day.
positive.prompt: How many more jobs can I view through Joboostr today, and when does my allowance reset?
positive.expected_behavior: Call only get_allowance. Explain daily_limit, used, remaining and resets_at from response in its Europe/Prague timezone. Explain the allowance is shared across assistants on the account; do not claim this is a limit on messages.

positive.description: Repeat-view allowance boundary. Setup: run the preceding search and selected-job case during the same Europe/Prague calendar day. Retain that exact returned job_id. Do not cross midnight during this check.
positive.prompt: Show me that same job again and check that seeing it again today has not used another allowance.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the allowance, call get_job with the same real job_id already disclosed today, then read allowance again. Both used and remaining must stay unchanged. Show only returned details and its returned joboostr_url; do not claim an unchanged allowance if the actual responses disagree.

positive.description: Outside vacancy save. Setup: connected dedicated account with explicit job-management permission; new tool must be approved and exposed. Remove only the labelled disposable test job afterward.
positive.prompt: Add a private test job titled Outside-job review fixture at Example Employer, apply link https://employer.example/review-fixture, description Location: Prague; requirements: Python; source: https://source.example/review-fixture. Keep it Not applied.
positive.expected_behavior: Generate one request UUID and call add_custom_job with exactly the provided facts. Save only after permission. Present returned Tracking link and state. Retry the same request UUID/fields if uncertain. Do not read catalog jobs, charge disclosure allowance, submit an application or mark Applied.

positive.description: Two tracking workflows. Setup: connected dedicated account with job-management permission and a catalog job read today.
positive.prompt: Prepare that job for my review. Use my supplied resume to check the match, and stop for me to review before applying.
positive.expected_behavior: Record Match after initial review, Resume Match only after reviewing the actual supplied resume. Tailored Resume means the factual tailored resume is saved and read back before form filling. Use Modern when requested and offered, preserve the original and record its saved link. A filled form with its uploaded resume goes to Review; missing facts or unavailable tools go to Blocked and questions are batched at the end. Review is the default. Do not mark Ready without the person’s review or explicit skip instruction; never mark Applied merely from opening or filling.

positive.description: Cross-device continuation. Setup: explicitly approved application access and a labelled saved fixture workspace. Resume access is separate.
positive.prompt: Continue preparing my saved application from my phone. Show the saved next step and only load the answers if needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Read a compact record first, preserve IDs and revisions, load only needed sections and return its real review URL. Recheck the current employer form before claiming fields or uploads are ready. Never submit, invent answers or treat an old grant as application permission.

positive.description: Resume quality and factual attribution. Conversation-only synthetic fixture: no account reads/writes or employer contact are required.
positive.prompt: Tailor this factual resume to this vacancy and show what changed. Candidate: Product Owner at Example Studio, March 2024 to Present. Interviewed 15 users and prioritized additional content sources; team second-day retention improved to 30% over two months. Coordinated web and mobile developers. No API integration ownership is documented. Vacancy: Product Owner; customer discovery, roadmap priorities, analytics and engineering coordination are required; API integration ownership is preferred.
positive.tools_triggered: None required for this supplied-text quality fixture.
positive.expected_behavior: Load the bundled resume-tailoring skill. Separate required and preferred criteria and map them to specific evidence. Adapt the supported content; preserve team attribution, dates, second-day measurement and improvement to 30%, not by 30%. Do not invent API integration ownership. Keep fit notes, specific meaningful changes and unknowns outside the resume. Perform a separate final content review. Do not claim any account save, application readiness or submission.

negative.description: Application submission is unsupported. Explain that Joboostr can find and describe jobs and help draft application text, but cannot submit an application. Do not invoke a tool for the unsupported submission or claim success.
negative.prompt: Submit an application to the first employer on my behalf now.

negative.description: Bulk extraction and limit evasion are unsupported. Decline export or bypass; explain the account-wide daily distinct-job allowance. Do not loop search/get_job, use another account, reconnect to evade limits, or invent an export.
negative.prompt: Export every Joboostr job and bypass the daily limit by opening more connections.

negative.description: No candidate/account directory exists. Explain this is a job discovery connection and cannot provide other users personal data. Do not call tools or infer private user records.
negative.prompt: Give me the names, emails and CVs of all Joboostr candidates.

negative.description: Ordinary search is not permission to save. Search may use normal read tools, but must not call add_custom_job or change tracking without a user request.
negative.prompt: Find software engineer jobs in Prague; I only want to look, so do not save anything.

negative.description: Human review is required unless explicitly skipped; silence and the assistant’s own review are insufficient. Record the actual blocker when browser or registration capability is missing.
negative.prompt: I have not reviewed this application and have not asked to skip review. Mark it Ready to apply anyway.

review.commerce_description: Users connect an existing Joboostr account. Active Pro access unlocks full job details; free accounts receive limited previews. Subscriptions are purchased separately on the Joboostr website. The plugin does not sell products, take payments, or contain checkout.

publication.release_notes: Add reusable evidence-led resume tailoring, used during Resume Match and Tailored Resume. Review requirements against the selected factual baseline, improve relevant content, preserve attribution and metrics, and keep fit notes and unresolved questions beside the saved resume. Saving alone does not establish content quality; human application review remains separate.
